acceptance_criteria.requirement: The exact Stage 4 predecessor, clean base, completion receipt, and every predecessor gate are verified.
Expected online state is reconstructed independently from pinned primitive source and definition inputs.
Comparison is exhaustive whenever bounded size permits.
Larger-workload sampling is deterministic, stratified, manifest-bound, and limitation-labeled.
Missing, extra, wrong, stale, expired, corrupt, null/default-divergent, and definition-mismatched records are detected.
Every activation-gate component has a negative test that blocks activation.
The prior generation remains active and readable for every rejected candidate.
Source, build, materialization, activation, online, TTL, and end-to-end lags remain distinct.
Correctness decisions use controlled clocks rather than uncontrolled wall time.
Metrics and log schemas cover the complete candidate and serving lifecycle.
Labels and correlation fields are bounded, non-sensitive, and validator-enforced.
An operator can diagnose every required stale or broken-generation scenario.
Workloads, seeds, distributions, environment, warm-up, repetitions, operation order, and analysis rules are frozen before measurement.
More than one scale and balanced, skewed, and high-cardinality profiles are measured.
Cold and warm behavior, repetitions, raw results, failures, and variability are preserved.
Incremental and full performance are compared only after canonical output equality passes.
Bottlenecks and scale limits are supported by captured evidence.
Claims use LOCAL_VERIFIED, MEASURED, EXTRAPOLATED, DESIGN_ONLY, or UNCLAIMED accurately.
No AWS runtime, cost, SLO, availability, or production-scale claim is inferred from Part 2.
Injected mismatches and stale or incomplete states fail closed and recover through legitimate APIs.
The complete skeptical walkthrough succeeds from a fresh checkout.
All Parts 1 and 2 quality, correctness, and evidence validators pass deterministically.
Exact-head CI, review, protected merge, push CI, and tree equality pass.
Fresh merged-main reproduction passes.
The Part 2 receipt binds commits, trees, runs, inputs, outputs, measurements, limitations, and the completion token.
